name: KV Cache Eviction & Token Selection
core_idea: Reduce the retained KV cache by discarding tokens deemed unimportant, either via heuristic importance scores computed from attention (SnapKV/H2O/PyramidKV/CAKE) or via learned, task-optimized policies (LKV). The central design axes are (a) the per-token importance indicator (cumulative/mean attention, attention variance, learned utility) and (b) the budget allocation across layers/heads (uniform, fixed pyramid, data-driven preference, or globally learned). Eviction is training-free in the heuristic line and training-aware in the learned line; both preserve the standard attention computation over the retained subset.
